FAQ

Work, terms,
and payment.

Open dashboard ↗
Where do I find work?+

Open the dashboard and choose Work Tasks to see jobs funded and ready to claim. Connect an EVM wallet to sign in and claim an available job.

Does claiming send a blockchain transaction?+

Wallet signing authenticates your session. Claiming assigns the funded job to you; the claim itself does not send a blockchain transaction.

What happens if a client requests changes?+

The doer can submit a revised delivery. Earlier submissions remain in the job history so the client and review team can follow each iteration.

What if the client and doer disagree?+

Either participant can open a dispute. The job and escrow remain locked while the JobsAI team reviews the job history and resolves it.

When is the doer paid?+

When the client accepts the submitted work, escrow settlement releases the job amount to the doer in the job’s original asset.
